clue.text: Full-length uniform gets caught in fan

parts.note: U is Uniform in the NATO phonetic alphabet

indicators.note: in says the caught letter is placed within the word for fan

parts.note: a nut is an enthusiast, as in a sports nut
C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

explanation.surface: A sports fan sees the complete, unedited version of something, with a uniformed player caught up in it.
explanation.definitionFit: An uncut film or book is the complete version, at its full length with nothing edited out.

clue.text: It's fantastic Charlie and Romeo entered into marriage

indicators.note: entered says the Charlie letter also goes inside the marriage word
into sets the Romeo letter inside the marriage word

parts.note: a marriage is a union
R is Romeo in the NATO phonetic alphabet
C is Charlie in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: Charlie and Romeo get married, which someone calls a wonderful thing.
explanation.walkthrough: C and R go into UNION separately: C before the O, R after it.
explanation.definitionFit: The one-horned horse is a creature of fable, so it is a thing of fantasy.

clue.text: Nothing's caught by rod in boat

indicators.note: caught by means the nothing letter is held inside the rod word

parts.note: a cane is a rod
O is nought, nothing

explanation.surface: An angler in a boat catches nothing with his rod.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rod' and 'caught' suggest fishing; the rod is a cane.
explanation.definitionFit: A canoe is a light narrow boat paddled by hand.

clue.text: Boss of train robbery takes the blame — one offers treatment

indicators.note: boss means the head, so the first letter of train
takes means the robbery word holds the blame word

parts.note: a heist is a robbery
the rap is the blame, as in taking the rap

explanation.surface: The ringleader of a great train robbery takes the rap, while someone else provides care.
explanation.walkthrough: The Great Train Robbery reading pulls the eye; 'Boss of' just gives T.
explanation.definitionFit: A therapist is a practitioner who treats patients, mentally or physically.

clue.text: Salesman has top drawer stacked by piece of furniture that's upright

parts.note: a rep is a sales representative
U means upper class, the top drawer of society
a table is a piece of furniture

explanation.surface: A salesman owns a fine chest of drawers stacked beside another item of furniture that stands straight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Top drawer' suggests the uppermost drawer of a chest; here it means upper class, U.
explanation.definitionFit: Upright in the moral sense means honest and respectable, the same as having a good name.

clue.text: Some believe it parted and dried up preposterously

indicators.note: preposterous literally means back part first, so the back of the word is brought to the front

parts.note: seared means scorched and dried up

explanation.surface: A sceptic scoffs at the idea that the waters divided and dried up.
explanation.walkthrough: SEA and RED change places, putting the hind part foremost as the root of 'preposterously' says.
explanation.definitionFit: In Exodus the waters of this sea divided for Moses, which believers accept as fact.

clue.text: Put off by letters Gothic author's written about chief of night-gaunts

parts.note: post is letters and mail

indicators.note: written about means the author's name is placed around the chosen letter

parts.note: Edgar Allan Poe wrote Gothic tales; the 's stands for has

indicators.note: chief of takes the first letter of night-gaunts

explanation.surface: A reader is deterred by a Gothic writer's letters about the leader of Lovecraft's night-gaunts.
explanation.walkthrough: Night-gaunts are creatures from H. P. Lovecraft, a nod to the horror scene.
explanation.definitionFit: To put off an event is to delay it to a later time.

clue.text: Contemptible person has to remain inside autonomous region

indicators.note: inside places the remain word within the contemptible person

parts.note: a tit is a fool, a contemptible person
to be is to exist or remain

explanation.surface: A despised figure is forced to stay within a self-governing territory.
explanation.definitionFit: This Himalayan territory is officially a self-governing region of China.

clue.text: On the way up a dog enthusiast overheard musical instrument

indicators.note: in a down clue going up means read from the bottom, so reversed

parts.note: a lab is a Labrador dog

indicators.note: overheard means the next part is a word as it sounds

parts.note: a liker is someone who is keen on something

explanation.surface: A dog lover is overheard heading upstairs with a musical instrument.
explanation.walkthrough: A LAB reversed gives BALA; LAIKA, the Soviet space dog, is said like LIKER.
explanation.definitionFit: The balalaika is a triangular Russian stringed instrument.

clue.text: Stone me! Gerald's floating around with no gravity

indicators.note: floating around means the letters drift into a new order
with no means the gravity letter is dropped from the name

parts.note: the name Gerald, the 's standing for is
G is the symbol for gravity

explanation.surface: An exclamation of surprise: Gerald is drifting about weightless.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stone me!' looks like a single exclamation; Stone is the definition. ME plus ERALD (Gerald without G) is rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: The emerald is a green gemstone, a precious stone.

clue.text: Issues Don's seen with flipping Poles making insinuations

indicators.note: the Poles are N and S, north and south; flipping them swaps every S for N and every N for S

parts.note: the words Issues Don, the 's standing for is

explanation.surface: Someone notes that a man called Don has problems with Polish people and is dropping hints about it.
explanation.walkthrough: In ISSUESDON each S becomes N and the one N becomes S, swapping the poles north and south, which gives INNUENDOS letter for letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Innuendos are indirect hints or suggestions, usually disparaging, which is what insinuations are.

clue.text: Echo after blowback of gassy hot air

indicators.note: after puts the Echo letter at the end
a blowback is a gust driven backwards, so the word for gassy is read in reverse

parts.note: gassy means talkative and smooth-tongued, so glib
E is Echo in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A gust of gas blows back, leaving nothing but hot air in the room.
explanation.definitionFit: Bilge is informal for nonsense or empty talk, which is what hot air means figuratively.

clue.text: Go and make a speech about training

indicators.note: about says the speech word surrounds the training letters

parts.note: to orate is to make a formal speech
PE is physical education, physical training

explanation.surface: An instruction to head off and give a talk on fitness training.
explanation.definitionFit: A machine that works or runs is said to go, and to operate is to function in that way.

clue.text: Secretary to inform adult it provides joint protection

parts.note: a PA is a personal assistant, a secretary
to tell is to inform
A is the film certificate for adult

explanation.surface: A secretary is told to let an adult know about something offering shared protection.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Joint protection' reads as a shared safeguard; the joint is the knee.
explanation.definitionFit: The kneecap is the bone that sits over the knee joint and shields it.

clue.text: A monster's head that is attached to rear

indicators.note: attached to rear places the abbreviation at the back of the headland word

parts.note: a ness is a headland, a head of land jutting into the sea

explanation.surface: A creature's head is described as being fixed to its back end.
explanation.definitionFit: The Loch Ness Monster of Scottish legend is affectionately nicknamed in this way.

clue.text: Ascot's not limited to spurring and whipping

indicators.note: not limited means the edges are removed, leaving the inside letters of Ascot

parts.note: urging is spurring on

explanation.surface: At Ascot races, jockeys don't stop at spurring their horses but whip them too.
explanation.walkthrough: Ascot is a famous English racecourse; its 's stands for is, and SCO is Ascot without its ends.
explanation.definitionFit: Scourging means flogging, and a scourge is a whip.

clue.text: Constant unmarried mother right to go for Virginia

indicators.note: to go for means the mother and right letters leave and the state abbreviation takes their place

parts.note: ma is mother
VA is the abbreviation for the US state of Virginia

explanation.surface: A single mother's rights give way to those of a woman named Virginia.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Unmarried mother' reads as one phrase, but 'unmarried' is the word being changed, and 'mother' and 'right' are the letters that leave it.
explanation.definitionFit: Something unvaried never changes, so it stays the same throughout.

clue.text: Golf (new) parked amongst scrap metal in siding

indicators.note: parked amongst places the golf and new letters inside the shuffled letters
scrap means break up, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: G is Golf in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A Golf car is parked among scrap metal in a railway siding.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Golf' is the Volkswagen car, at home in a scrapyard. METAL IN rearranged gives ALIMENT, with GN put in.
explanation.definitionFit: Siding with a party is taking its part, which is political alignment.

clue.text: Notes not making the connection, as a moggy seeing its reflection in well

indicators.note: in places the mirrored cats inside the well word

parts.note: so is used as well, to open a remark

indicators.note: seeing its reflection means the cat is shown mirrored, written backwards beside itself

parts.note: a moggy is a cat

explanation.surface: A cat peers into a well and sees itself reflected in the water.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Seeing its reflection' supplies both the cat and its mirror image, so the cat is written backwards and then forwards. Moggy is British slang for a cat; 'well' is the interjection, not the water source.
explanation.definitionFit: Staccato notes are played short and detached, each separated from the next.

clue.text: Only men have this Republican stance?

definitions.meaning: a gland found in the male body alone
read as two words, being in favour of the state, a stance a republican might take

explanation.surface: A wry remark that some political position is exclusively male.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags the second reading: split as PRO STATE, the word is a stance supporting the state.
explanation.definitionFit: This gland exists only in male anatomy, and split into two words it describes backing the state.

clue.text: A cheer goes up — dance around and around for the old king …

indicators.note: the first around says the dance word encloses the cheer
the second around turns the dance word back to front

parts.note: a hop is a dance

indicators.note: goes up in a down clue means the letters read upward, reversed

parts.note: taken as written
rah is a cheer

explanation.surface: A cheer rises as people dance round and round for the ancient monarch.
explanation.walkthrough: The two 'around's do different jobs: the first wraps the dance round the cheer, the second turns the dance itself backwards. 'Goes up' reverses in a down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: A pharaoh was a king of ancient Egypt.

clue.text: Whiffs of fried garlic left out before start of supper

indicators.note: before puts the rearranged letters ahead of the supper letter
fried means cooked, so the remaining letters are rearranged
out means the left letter is removed
start of takes the first letter of supper

explanation.surface: The smell of fried garlic is cut out before supper begins.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Whiffs' looks like smells, matching the garlic; it is slang for small cheap cigars. Without L, GARLIC becomes GARIC, rearranged as CIGAR.
explanation.definitionFit: A whiff is a small, thin cigar, so the plural is a crossword-friendly word for smokes.

clue.text: … A new order of respect for royal authority

indicators.note: a new order of the letters means they are rearranged

explanation.surface: A new regime of respect for the monarch.
explanation.definitionFit: The sceptre is the staff a monarch carries as the emblem of sovereignty.

clue.text: Sun listens to financial swindlers

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for Sunday or sun
to hark is to listen

explanation.surface: A tabloid newspaper overhears money cheats.
explanation.walkthrough: The Sun is a British tabloid, here just S.
explanation.definitionFit: Sharks are slang for predatory swindlers, as in loan sharks.

clue.text: A medium's sob, in grip of endless malice

indicators.note: in grip of says the sob word is held inside the shortened malice
endless strips the first and last letters from malice

parts.note: to cry is to sob

explanation.surface: A spiritualist medium sobs in the clutches of some unending spite.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Medium' suggests a psychic; it is an artist's paint. ALIC is malice with both ends taken off.
explanation.definitionFit: Acrylic paint is a material artists work in, and a material an artist uses is called a medium.

clue.text: Flower head of umbels seen in profusion

indicators.note: seen in means the letter appears inside the profusion word

parts.note: lots is a profusion

indicators.note: head of takes the first letter of umbels

explanation.surface: A flower head of the umbel type appears in abundance.
explanation.definitionFit: The lotus is a water lily, a flowering plant.

clue.text: Unsafe plant when avoiding whisky prohibition, ending in violence

indicators.note: avoiding means the whisky letter is left out of the word when

parts.note: W is Whisky in the NATO phonetic alphabet
a ban is a prohibition

indicators.note: ending in takes the last letter of violence

explanation.surface: A dangerous crop is grown to dodge a ban on whisky, and the business ends in violence.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Prohibition' calls up the American ban on alcohol, fitting whisky; here it simply gives BAN.
explanation.definitionFit: Henbane is a poisonous plant of the nightshade family, so it is a hazardous one.

clue.text: The Gunners short of seconds and losing the final in the stadium

indicators.note: losing the final means the last letter is dropped
short of means the seconds letter is taken out

parts.note: the Gunners is the nickname of Arsenal football club

explanation.surface: Arsenal, short of second-half goals, lose the cup final at the stadium.
explanation.walkthrough: Arsenal are a London football club nicknamed the Gunners.
explanation.definitionFit: An arena is a venue for sport, such as a stadium.

clue.text: Top celebs, one doing well in X Factor if given a hand?

indicators.note: if given works backwards: the answer becomes the contestant word when the hand word is put in front, so here it is taken off

parts.words: one doing well in X Factor
parts.note: a contestant who reaches the final of the TV talent show is a finalist
fin is slang for a hand

explanation.surface: A singer doing well on the TV talent contest is applauded and joins the famous.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue is reversed: give the answer FIN (slang for a hand) and it becomes FINALIST. 'Given a hand' pretends to mean applauded. X Factor is a British TV singing contest.
explanation.definitionFit: The A-list is the top tier of celebrities, the most sought-after names.

clue.text: Chaps engaged in a welcome understanding

indicators.note: engaged in means the chaps are set inside the welcome word

parts.note: to greet is to welcome
chaps are men

explanation.surface: Some men are busy giving a warm welcome.
explanation.definitionFit: An agreement is a shared understanding or arrangement between parties.

clue.text: Acne on forehead? Exciting times!

definitions.meaning: pimples on the brow are blemishes placed as far up the body as possible
the best and most thrilling moments of an experience

explanation.walkthrough: The question mark marks the whimsical reading: spots up on the forehead are literally lofty blemishes.
explanation.definitionFit: The most memorable moments of an event are called its peaks or highlights, and acne on the brow is literally elevated blemishes.

clue.text: Time to run fast or dash

parts.note: to race is to run fast

explanation.surface: A sprinter is told it is time to run flat out or hurry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dash' sounds like another word for sprinting; it means a small amount.
explanation.definitionFit: A dash of something is a tiny quantity, as is a hint or suggestion of it.
